measurement.scope: One synthetic832+54+208-record profile, eight10000-draw endpoints, through serialization; no target profile.
measurement.planning_limitations: Synthetic values/timing are a cost estimate, not a worst-case guarantee; original metadata hashing report supplies observed IO.

scope_limits: Own parsing/statistics of complete saved records, no producer/model execution or new generation.
Canonical integer disagreement is primary; saved answers_differ is raw-text disagreement.
All96 frozen problem indices retained, including source-known duplicates/overlaps and one previously smoke-tested held-out instance of unidentified index.
Eight development instances are not held-out endpoints; mechanism contains six problem units with three dependent perturbations per temperature.
Separate seed0 PCG64 bootstrap/sign-flip; linear quantiles; plus-one and raw p retained. Producer inline RNG code unavailable.
Original full trajectory and answer token IDs unavailable; exact trajectory and hard-token flags remain reviewed-source claims.
BF16 soft distances are on float32 expected embeddings before bf16 input cast; no post-cast state-distance reconstruction.
Forced32 greedy tokens plus cue plus8 answer tokens is the comparator, not early-stop greedy accuracy.
Growing context differs from fixed one-slot autonomous map; finite operational effect does not establish chaos attribution.
Producer numerical summary exposed before replay; no claim of blinded validation or independently reconstructed historical remote model bytes.
